(async()=>{ const p=__app.player, v=p.video, view=p.view; v.pause(); v.currentTime=2; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,800)); view.reset&&view.reset(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400)); const stats=(d)=>{ let n=0,S=0,L=0,R=0,G=0,B=0; for(let i=0;i<d.length;i+=4){ const r=d[i],g=d[i+1],b=d[i+2]; const mx=Math.max(r,g,b),mn=Math.min(r,g,b); if(mx<8) continue; n++; S+=(mx-mn)/mx; L+=0.2126*r+0.7152*g+0.0722*b; R+=r;G+=g;B+=b; } return {sat:+(S/n).toFixed(3), luma:+(L/n).toFixed(1), rgb:[R/n,G/n,B/n].map(x=>Math.round(x)).join(',')}; }; const c=document.createElement('canvas'); c.width=v.videoWidth; c.height=v.videoHeight; const g=c.getContext('2d',{willReadFrequently:true}); g.drawImage(v,0,0); const ew=c.width/2; const src=stats(g.getImageData(Math.round(ew*0.35),Math.round(c.height*0.35),Math.round(ew*0.3),Math.round(c.height*0.3)).data); const gl=view.renderer.getContext(); const W=gl.drawingBufferWidth,H=gl.drawingBufferHeight; view.render(); const px=new Uint8Array(W*H*4); gl.readPixels(0,0,W,H,gl.RGBA,gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE,px); const vr=stats(px); const cs=getComputedStyle(v); return {src_center30pct: src, vr_whole_view: vr}; })()
